description: Drainage Assets is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. This dataset contains gully information on all roads in Northern Ireland that are adopted and maintained by DfI Roads. This includes the geospatial position, local street, and council area. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Assets, DRD, Drainage, Gullies. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV., XML. The portal shows 2024-11-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
